scientific_integrity: The proof establishes the exact all-real-positive price regime, unique optimizer and gap eigenspace multiplicity. Finite exact-rational checks are supplementary; no independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Continuous-time spectral gap only, not discrete-time transition matrices, general trees, vertex weighting or individual edge caps. Generic SDP formulation predates this explicit solution; specialized historical overlap not excluded.
scientific_scope: Unit-mass combinatorial Laplacian of a fixed star, at least two leaves; arbitrary strictly positive linear edge prices and positive total conductance budget.
title: Exact priced-star spectral-gap allocation and the polygon threshold
